name: QIE Dashboard Kit
description: Dashboard components for preact + htm with live QIE Mainnet data: stat cards, sparklines, bar charts, sortable tables and tabs, drawn in plain SVG.
readme:
The QIE Dashboard Kit gives a preact + htm app everything a dashboard needs, and live data from QIE Mainnet to show in it.

Components
- StatCard with trend deltas and loading skeletons
- Sparkline and BarChart in plain SVG: no chart library
- DataTable, sortable by any column
- Tabs, Skeleton and EmptyState

Data
- recentBlocks and useLiveBlocks: the latest QIE Mainnet blocks, refreshed on an interval
- blockStats: block time, transactions per block, gas used

Getting started
1. Buy the kit, then press Clone into my apps to open the live demo dashboard in the App Builder.
2. Copy dashboard-kit.js, dashboard-kit.css and contract.js into your own app folder.
3. Link dashboard-kit.css in index.html and import the components you need.
4. Feed them your own contract reads, or the block data helpers.
5. Theme it with the --ds- CSS variables on :root.
